## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the user-visible problem and how this change resolves it.

## Validation

- [ ] Relevant tests pass with `npm run check`.
- [ ] English/Chinese documentation and examples match the final behavior.
- [ ] Screenshots are included for visual changes.
- [ ] Configuration changes and migration steps are explained here and in the affected English/Chinese user guides.

## Compatibility

State any dependency, browser, Hexo, or configuration compatibility changes.
